threeActStructure.description: Slow build-up in Act 1, increasing tension in Act 2, and rapid climax in Act 3

varyingSceneLengths.description: Quick cuts for energy, longer takes for depth, mixing it up to prevent monotony

measuredPacing.description: Slower, more consistent rhythm to allow for information absorption

alternatingTempos.description: Slower rhythms for reflection, quicker tempos for high-energy segments

fastPacedRhythm.description: Quick cuts, dynamic camera movements, and rapid scene transitions to heighten tension

contrast.description: Alternating between fast and slow pacing to create unpredictability and keep viewers engaged

snappyPacing.description: Rapid-fire dialogues and precise editing to land jokes effectively

wellTimedPauses.description: Strategic use of pauses to enhance comedic timing

balancedPacing.description: Alternating between fast-paced, high-energy segments and slower, more informative sections

deliberatePacing.description: Slower pace for complex concepts, allowing viewers to absorb information

energeticPacing.description: Faster and more dynamic to generate enthusiasm and encourage action

musicDrivenRhythm.description: Using upbeat music combined with quick-paced editing to create momentum
